info.name: Dell Servers Dell iDRAC Redfish REST Accounts Chassis API

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of chassis resources representing the physical enclosure of the server including power supplies, fans, thermal sensors, and physical component inventory.

info.name: Dell Servers Get a chassis resource

params.name: ChassisId
params.description: Identifier for the chassis resource, typically System.Embedded.1 for Dell PowerEdge servers

items.docs: Retrieves a specific chassis resource with detailed information about the physical enclosure, including model, serial number, part number, asset tag, indicator LED state, and links to power and thermal resources.

info.name: Dell Servers Get chassis power information

params.name: ChassisId
params.description: Identifier for the chassis resource, typically System.Embedded.1 for Dell PowerEdge servers

items.docs: Retrieves power supply information, power consumption metrics, and power control settings for the specified chassis including current wattage, power capacity, and power supply redundancy status.

info.name: Dell Servers Get chassis thermal information

params.name: ChassisId
params.description: Identifier for the chassis resource, typically System.Embedded.1 for Dell PowerEdge servers

items.docs: Retrieves thermal sensor readings, fan speeds, and temperature thresholds for the specified chassis. Includes inlet and exhaust temperatures, CPU temperatures, and fan status with redundancy information.
